label: Hacker News
terms_note: Free, unauthenticated, read-only: https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0/item/{id}.json, /user/{id}.json, /topstories.json, /newstories.json, /askstories.json, /showstories.json, /jobstories.json, /maxitem.json, /updates.json (Firebase realtime streaming too); no rate limit published; posting / voting / commenting have NO API — HN guidelines expect humans ('write your text by hand', no vote rings, no marketing accounts).

endpoints.call: walk `kids` of a story item recursively
endpoints.purpose: each kid is a comment item with `parent`, `text`

reference.limits: - No published rate limit; be polite (Firebase quotas). The API is read-only — submitting, commenting and voting have no API, and HN guidelines expect humans (no vote rings, no marketing accounts, "write your text by hand"). - Item ids are monotonic (`maxitem`), so a watcher can scan the id range since its last checkpoint. - Algolia's `hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search` is a third-party full-text search over the same data (also read-only).

me.note: Unauthenticated read-only API: there is no account; the probe reads /v0/maxitem.json to confirm the API is reachable.

analytics_post.note: Item record: `score` and `descendants` (total comment count) are the only metrics HN publishes; the runtime cannot compose a nested `metrics` object, so they are top-level fields.

not_offered.publish_text: Hacker News has no write API (submitting, commenting and voting are human-only per the guidelines).
not_offered.read_comments: GET /v0/item/{id}.json returns only comment ids in `kids`; each comment is a further GET /v0/item/{kid}.json and the runtime has no id-list fan-out (needs_runtime).
not_offered.read_mentions: The official API has no search or mention endpoint (hn.algolia.com is third-party).
